brief: tall wooden staff topped by a copper lightning-rod coil and a small glass bulb (storm-village elder prop)
biome: all (NPC accessory, attaches to installed humanoid cast)
author: Claude (coordinator-side Meshy NPC-accessory worker), owner-authorized Meshy use (Standing owner direction 1, 15 Oct 2026)
workflow: agent-drafted multi-view concept from the repo key art (Meshy image-to-image nano-banana-pro, reference as data URI) -> inspected -> Meshy image-to-3d (latest, quad remesh, target 2500, PBR textures embedded) -> Meshy remesh (triangle topology, target 3600) to meet the <4k-triangle budget -> embedded textures resized to 1024 px JPEG -> lossless metres normalisation -> origin moved to the attach point

native_size.note: Meshy remesh GLB, longest side ~1.9 units

scale_normalisation.method: lossless: GLB scene roots wrapped in node 'metres_root' with uniform scale + translation; base at y=0, footprint centred on x/z, then translation shifted so the attach point is the origin
scale_normalisation.source_glb: Meshy remesh output (triangle topology, target 3600) of the chosen image-to-3d model, textures re-encoded

texture_repack.method: every embedded image resized to <=1024 px and re-encoded JPEG q92 (Meshy remesh baked 2048-4096 px PNG)

origin.attach_point: hand grip on the shaft axis, 0.90 m up from the foot
origin.note: normalised frame = base at y=0, x/z centred; origin_offset is added to every vertex (glTF +y up, Meshy front faces +z)

previews: preview_meshy.png (Meshy thumbnail of the image-to-3d source model)
preview_3view.png (software flat-shaded 3-view of the final GLB, colours sampled per face)
files.raw_glb: not published (Meshy image-to-3d and remesh outputs kept only as task ids)

concepts.prompt: A tall wooden walking staff carried by a storm-village elder: straight honey-brown hardwood shaft with a leather-wrapped hand grip about halfway up, topped by a copper lightning-rod coil spiralling around a short copper spike, with a small clear glass bulb holding a faint pale-blue spark, a few copper bands down the shaft. Style: Palworld / Animo-class stylised game asset, chunky simplified readable silhouette that reads at 15 metres, slightly oversized key shapes, soft hand-painted PBR materials, warm natural palette taken from the reference key art (honey wood, warm brass and copper, slate blue, teal, mustard, moss green, cream). Single isolated object only, floating on a plain flat light-grey background, no ground, no shadow scene, no character, no body, no hands, no mannequin, no text, no logo. Absolutely no red, no oxblood, no maroon, no crimson, no pink anywhere. Show the same object from three views: front, three-quarter and side, consistent design.
references: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MJohnsonWellabe/Tetherbound/main/docs/reference/tetherbound-meadows-keyart.png (1536 x 1024 source re-encoded as JPEG q90 at 1536 px; local derived file keyart_1536.jpg): project palette and stylised finish
concepts.verdict: CHOSEN (view 0 as single-image input; all three views were the same front view): straight honey-wood shaft, copper bands, sage leather grip wrap mid-shaft, copper coil spiralling round a short spike under a pale glass bulb; plain background, no body, no red

models.verdict: CHOSEN as source mesh (4,876 tris raw) -> remeshed
models.kept: source for remesh r1 only; raw GLB not published

visual_verdict.text: Clear tall-staff silhouette: honey hardwood shaft with copper bands and a sage leather wrap, copper coil spiralling up to a pale glass bulb. Reads as a storm rod at 15 m. The shaft is chunky (about 0.11-0.13 m across), stylised rather than a realistic 4 cm grip, so the NPC hand may need a slightly open pose. The bulb is pale grey-white glass with no glow; an emissive tint would need a material override at integration.

integration_note: candidate only; stays flag-off until its scene passes code-blind judging
palette_check: base-colour texture scan of the final GLB (hue <= 12 or >= 320 deg, sat >= 0.35, val >= 0.2): 0.15% of texels, all dark shaded copper/wood edge texels, no red/oxblood/pink surface
